title: Chowdhury Mueen Uddin and Ashrafuzzaman Khan found guilty on 11 charges
note: Bangladesh Trial Observer summary of the 3 November 2013 ICT-2 verdict sentencing Chowdhury Mueen Uddin and Ashrafuzzaman Khan to death in absentia in the intellectual-killings case.
whyItMatters: It summarizes the ICT-2 verdict in the case most directly tied to the December 1971 intellectual killings.
